1 cell = 1 world unit · x east · +Z south = gameplay camera side · layout for review, not structural engineering
Hall · screens · service end · two-storey kitchen · donjon guard hall · armory & chapel wing · court entrances, door reserves, stair pairs
1 cell = 1 world unit · x east · +Z south = gameplay camera side · layout for review, not structural engineering
DOOR SCHEDULE (dashed red = swing reserve, keep clear)
D1 Great Hall ⇄ Inner court (4 wide, swings N)
D2 Screens Passage ⇄ Inner court (2.5 wide, swings N)
D3 Screens Passage ⇄ Great Hall (3 wide, swings W)
D4 Screens Passage ⇄ Buttery (2 wide, swings E)
D5 Screens Passage ⇄ Service Passage (2 wide, swings E)
D6 Service Passage ⇄ Great Kitchen (2 wide, swings E)
D7 Screens Passage ⇄ Pantry (2 wide, swings E)
D8 Great Kitchen ⇄ Inner court (3 wide, swings N)
D9 Great Hall ⇄ Donjon Guard Hall (2 wide, swings W)
D10 Donjon Guard Hall ⇄ Guardroom & Armory (2 wide, swings S)
D11 Guardroom & Armory ⇄ Inner court (2 wide, swings W)
D12 Guardroom & Armory ⇄ Chapel (2 wide, swings S)
D13 Chapel ⇄ Inner court (3 wide, swings W)
D14 Barracks ⇄ Lower ward (3 wide, swings S)
D15 Stables ⇄ Lower ward (4 wide, swings W)
D16 Smithy ⇄ Lower ward (2 wide, swings E)
STAIRS (S = fade pairs at the same x,z; W = built flights +0 → +7)
W1 flight along the cross wall, foot landing in the inner court → +7 landing (wall-walk sheet)
W2 flight along the SE curtain (lower ward) → SE tower +7 (wall-walk sheet)
Kitchen yard (deliveries, wood, water from well) → kitchen D8.
Kitchen → service passage D6 → screens D5; buttery D4 (casks, drink)
and pantry D7 (bread, stores) open off the same screens.
Servers enter the hall at D3, behind the table ends — never through guests.
Guests enter by the great door D1 from the feast court; lord's party
arrives at the dais from the donjon D9.
Central hearth (louver above) lights two long tables + high table.
White dashed south faces = camera-side cutaway (walls cut to 1.2).
Main lanes 3-4 cells: hall aisle south of the tables, court routes.
Hall: 19×16 cells; aisle y 24-28 kept clear for the approach route.
Guard: armory D11 to court; donjon reachable only via hall dais
Lower ward rooms (barracks, stables, smithy) on overview sheet.
